name: Europe PMC, open access, full text in JATS XML — the 272 articles of the August 2026 observation
source: Europe PMC REST API (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/), full-text XML endpoint
selection: eight strata drawn by query on the Europe PMC search API, open access with full text (OPEN_ACCESS:Y AND HAS_FT:Y), 34 per stratum where available; strata: bio, cas (case reports), essai (clinical trials), meta (meta-analyses and systematic reviews), moderne (2024-2026), nonEN (non-English), phys (physics/maths), retract (retraction notices)
note: The articles are public and open access; the list lets anyone re-download the same 272 files from Europe PMC by PMC identifier. The XML files themselves are not redistributed here.

articles.licence: open access, licence text without CC name
open access, licence text without CC name
open access, licence text without CC name

queries.base: OPEN_ACCESS:Y AND HAS_FT:Y AND FIRST_PDATE:[2023-01-01 TO 2026-12-31] (base; stratum filters below appended with AND)
queries.nonEN: (LANG:"fre" OR LANG:"ger" OR LANG:"spa" OR LANG:"por")
queries.moderne: OPEN_ACCESS:Y AND HAS_FT:Y AND FIRST_PDATE:[2024-01-01 TO 2026-12-31]

how_to_reproduce: For each PMC id: GET https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/<PMCID>/fullTextXML . Europe PMC may have updated a record since 2026-08-08; a re-download is a new snapshot, to be dated.
download: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/<PMCID>/fullTextXML (the JATS XML, exactly what the probes read) · human view: https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/<PMCID>

frozen_copy.status: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22680055, published 2026-09-09: 267 files as read on 2026-08-08, under a named Creative Commons licence, with this manifest (6.5 MB)
frozen_copy.why: two under a publisher licence forbidding redistribution, three saying only 'Creative Commons' without the type
frozen_copy.how_to_check: sha256 of each file as read on 2026-08-08 is in this record; a re-download whose hash differs is a new version of the article

document_years.reading: the name says 2023-2026 because that is the query window. The harvest returned 2025 and 2026 only. Read every prevalence measured here as a figure about 2025-2026 publishing.
